messages:
Ava (PM): Heads-up: execs want a short GA checklist focused on SLA, docs, support, monitoring, and pricing. Can we close gaps by EOD?
Miguel (Eng): I can confirm SLA metrics (uptime calc + p99 latency) and provide the small SDK snippets for docs.
Sofia (Legal): Will need to review SLA reparations + exclusions. Prefer a simple credit formula and a clear escalation verification flow.
Harper (SRE): Monitoring items: synthetic P95 check, KV-cache hitrate metric, and a perf baseline dashboard. Also want a suppression plan for noisy alerts during ramp.
Noah (Finance): Pricing: need final SKUs and burst policy text. Also confirm pilot promo (yes/no) and how it applies to committed usage.
Priya (Docs): Docs status: quickstart and API reference done. Missing: troubleshooting runbook, billing FAQ, and rollback steps. Can someone paste rollback bullets?
Miguel (Eng): Rollback draft:
```
1) Switch routed traffic to fallback-model
2) Remove requests from affected pool
3) Scale reserve capacity if available
4) Run smoke tests and validate P95
5) Re-enable normal routing
```
Priya (Docs): Perfect. I'll add that. Also need a minimal error-handling example for 429 in SDK snippet.
Miguel (Eng): Snippet: `if resp.status == 429: raise RetryOrUpgrade()`  will expand in docs.
Harper (SRE): For SLA measurement: incidents <5m should not count toward downtime. We should merge contiguous short glitches. Legal OK with that? @Sofia
Sofia (Legal): Yes, we prefer an explicit exclusion for <5m transient events. I'll draft redlines.
Noah (Finance): Promo: suggest PROMO-GA-1 (3mo 10% off) opt-in only. Need Billing to create code.
Ava (PM): Opt-in by default? we should make it opt-in so customers must request. Reduces surprise.
Sofia (Legal): Opt-in is safer legally. I'll add consent language.
OpsBot: Scheduled smoke-run 2026-04-02T08:00:00Z. Participants: @Harper @Miguel @Priya @Ava.
Priya (Docs): ETA for final snippets and legal redlines? I can merge docs after that.
Miguel (Eng): I'll drop final SDK + curl examples in 30m.
Sofia (Legal): Sending SLA redlines in ~2h.
Noah (Finance): I'll provision the promo in billing once SKU names are confirmed.
Ava (PM): OK owners recap: SLA wording + legal = Sofia; Rollback + SDK = Miguel; Monitoring + suppression = Harper; Pricing + promo = Noah; Docs merge = Priya. Target: EOD. Shout if you hit blockers. :rocket:
